risk_factors.heading: We must attract and retain qualified personnel to be successful, and competition for qualified personnel has intensified.
risk_factors.quote: Our failure to attract and retain hardware and software engineers, as well as sales and marketing personnel, could delay product development and introduction, thereby adversely affecting our net sales.

risk_factors.heading: The occurrence of events for which we are self-insured, or which exceed our insurance limits, may adversely affect our profitability and liquidity.
risk_factors.quote: Should there be a loss or adverse judgment in an area for which we are self-insured, then our financial condition, results of operations and liquidity may be materially adversely affected.
